Definition: from G2596 and G1850; to have (wield) full privilege over:--exercise authority.
BiblicalUsage: The princes of the Gentiles exercise authority upon them, and they that are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise authority upon them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the world's authority presses down, and Christ's authority lifts up.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
